149.title: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929
149.text:
2. In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,- (a) "child" means a person who, if a male, is under twenty-one years of age, and if a female, is under eighteen years of age.
12. (1) The Court may issue an injunction prohibiting a child marriage in contravention of this Act. (5) Whoever knowing that an injunction has been issued against him under sub-section (1) of this section disobeys such injunction shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand Taka, or with both.
